requestBody.query: Which networks broadcast basketball games on Bell Satellite TV?

200.answer:
You can watch NBA and NCAA basketball games on Bell Satellite TV.

- TSN broadcasts on channels 400-404 and 1400.
- Sportsnet broadcasts on channels 1405-1410 and 1414.
